name: test-runner-injected-globals
description: A test runner configuration that injects the runner's globals declares them to each compiler configuration of its manifest's directory that can resolve their declarations, so a test that calls them carries no type error and its dead store is judged, and a file only tests reach that calls one carries test evidence, as an import of the runner does, so the helper a test uses is test code. The fixture's run is answered at min_confidence possible, where a helper that is production code only tests use would be reported.
